# Operating Model

Who does what, who decides, and what happens when people disagree. Governance fails far more often on unclear accountability than on missing documents.

| [Roles & Responsibilities](roles-responsibilities.md) | <span class="pill ready">Ready</span> | Defines each governance role in enough detail that it can be put in a job description, recruited for, and assessed against — rather than assumed. |
